title: Hatsune Miku — Yokohama? I Predict Good Food♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's so many shops and places in this Yokohama guidebook Minori left for us.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's see, Minori said that she and her group are going to...
Chinatown, was it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Check this out, Miku!
This steamed bun is shaped like a panda!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It is!
It's called a “panda bun”. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this castella looks so soft and yummy!
I wonder what it tastes like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, then I'll get some for you as a souvenir!
We can all share!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope she and her group get to eat all of the things they want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's stuff about the Red Brick Center on this page.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka said that she and her group are going to go shopping there. I'm sure it'll be fun just looking around since there's so many shops.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What are you reading so intensely, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was reading through the Yokohama guidebook. Minori, Haruka and their classes will be going there for a field trip♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! There's a huge red building and the sea!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place is called the Red Brick Center.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well it definitely lives up to its name, given the red bricks. Looks historical too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apparently it used to be a warehouse for the harbor. Here, it says so in the guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! So, it has three floors, huh? It looks really big and has lots of shops!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Haruka said she wasn't even sure if they'll get to see everything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's also Chinatown and the Ferris wheel too. Looks like there's a lot of fun places to go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Hey, where's Minori going?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She said Chinatown. Which page was it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't that where that magnificent gate is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, it is. Oh, here's the page!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! That is magnificent! And huge too! There's a lot of people taking photos in front of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. But it looks like the food vendors are the selling point of this place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, look at where Minori put her sticky notes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, that's amazing! There's so many food places!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It seems like they stretch on and on once you go through the gate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Authentic dim sum, broiled sweet chestnuts, castella... Everything looks so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently even the steamed buns taste different depending on the shop, which makes you just want to try all of them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's this? Sounds like someone is quite the glutton.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! G-Give me a break. Airi said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope Minori and the others have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I told them to try to relax since they're always working so hard, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Haruka and Minori will be changing to the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Which means they won't get to be in the same class as their friends in the general education course...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's why I want them to enjoy the field trip with their friends as regular high school students.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. Wanna look and decide what places we would want to see if we were going?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds like so much fun♪ Yeah, let's!
